request.style: English, male baritone solo, deep choir, cello, organ, harp, warm and reverent, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Allon, son of Jedajah, stands in the line
Father of Shiphji, his name is divine
No deed of his hand is written in stone
But in the genealogy he is known

[Verse]
They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual
In Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, without fail
Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, the towns
Where they dwelt until David, the king, was found

[Verse]
Their villages Etam, Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen
With Ashan, five towns, the record is spoken
Around these towns as far as Baal
They kept a genealogical record in the hall

[Verse]
They went to the entrance of Gedor, east side of the valley
To look for pasture for their flocks, steadily
They found rich, good pasture, the land was broad
Quiet and peaceful, where the Hamites had trod

[Verse]
In the days of Hezekiah, they came with might
Attacked the tents, put the Meunites to flight
Destroyed them completely, so it remains
They settled in their place, answering the chains

[Outro]
Recorded by name, in the covenant kept
